# Remote Debugging Requirements Quality Checklist: Local Containerized Services

**Purpose**: Formal Platform, Ops, and Developer Experience requirements-quality review for feature `021-remote-debugging`  
**Created**: 2026-09-19  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context, planning artifacts, and user-specified review priorities.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are JDWP remote debugging requirements explicitly specified for all 8 application microservices without omission? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 - Is non-suspending startup behavior (`suspend=n`) mandated for every containerized service to prevent boot blocking? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 - Are exact host and in-container port mappings defined for each service in a dedicated reference table? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 - Are documentation requirements in `README.md` complete with dedicated subsections, port tables, and IDE setup guides? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements for simultaneous multi-service debugging sessions across distinct services explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 - Are memory constraints and JVM headroom requirements documented when injecting JDWP agents into `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS`? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]

---

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [x] CHK007 - Is the container network interface binding syntax (`address=*:<port>`) unambiguously specified to prevent loopback-only binding? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the 1:1 host-to-container port mapping relationship (`508x:508x`) articulated with explicit symmetry? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK009 - Are step-by-step connection parameters (transport mode, host, port, suspend behavior) clearly specified for IntelliJ IDEA, VS Code, and Eclipse? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the expected JVM behavior upon unexpected debugger detachment while paused at a breakpoint explicitly detailed? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the location and syntax of the Compose configuration modification (`infrastructure/docker-compose.apps.yml`) unambiguously identified? [Clarity, Plan §Project Structure]

---

## 3. Requirement Consistency & Alignment

- [x] CHK012 - Do the debug port allocations in the functional requirements align exactly with the clarified 1:1 scheme (`5080` and `5082`–`5088`)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the format of `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS` consistent across all 8 microservice definitions in planning and contract artifacts? [Consistency, Plan §Project Structure, Contracts §debug-port-allocation.json]
- [x] CHK014 - Are the socket transport protocol (`dt_socket`) and connection type specifications consistent across all IDE setup requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK015 - Do the requirements align with the project constitution regarding microservice isolation and zero regression on automated test suites? [Consistency, Constitution §Principle I & V]

---

## 4. Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [x] CHK016 - Is the non-blocking container startup criterion defined with objectively testable conditions (all containers healthy without debugger attached)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the debugger connection time threshold (< 30 seconds) objectively verifiable through user testing? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK018 - Are socket accessibility acceptance criteria defined in measurable, scriptable terms (100% of debug ports reachable)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the automated test verification requirement strictly quantifiable (100% pass rate on `./mvnw clean test`)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

---

## 5. Operational Safety & Environment Isolation

- [x] CHK020 - Is the boundary between local development Compose configuration and production container packaging explicitly defined? [Isolation, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 - Are requirements specified to prevent JDWP agent options from being baked into base production container images? [Security, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 - Does the specification require that Actuator health endpoints and readiness probes function unaffected during debugging? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK023 - Are host port collision boundaries explicitly defined against all active infrastructure ports (PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Keycloak, Mailpit, OTel, OpenSearch)? [Safety, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 - Is socket exposure restricted to `localhost` on the developer host machine without exposing public ingress? [Security, Spec §Assumptions]

---

## 6. Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK025 - Are requirements specified for concurrent debugging sessions where two or more developers/IDEs connect to different services simultaneously? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 - Are fallback or recovery requirements specified if a target debug port is already occupied on the developer host machine? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for JVM thread resumption when an IDE debugger terminates abnormally? [Recovery Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK028 - Are requirements specified for container restart behavior after updating Compose environment variables? [Lifecycle, Gap]

---

## 7. Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK029 - Are local host development prerequisites (Java 26, Docker Compose v2, standard IDEs) documented and bounded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK030 - Is the assumption of standard JDWP socket transport (`dt_socket`) support across all developer tooling explicitly validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK031 - Are dependencies on `infrastructure/docker-compose.apps.yml` clearly identified as the sole configuration target? [Dependency, Plan §Project Structure]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK031) for easy reference
